description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yang], [Apex Five Star Crimson Palm Damage Tracker] and [Apex Five Star Crimson Palm Level]

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yang
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Five Star Crimson Palm (0~2), removed after using Apex Five Star Crimson Palm two times

description.name: Apex Five Star Crimson Palm Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Five Star Crimson Palm level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yang]

description.name: Apex Five Star Crimson Palm Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Five Star Crimson Palm level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Yang]
